title: HostDeliveryReceiptV1
description: MBR-010: a host-issued proof that the host natively loaded a specific piece of content for a specific session. A block may only be recorded as native-delivered when a receipt matches client + sessionId + sourceHash. An absent receipt yields delivery=missing; a present-but-mismatched or malformed receipt yields delivery=unknown; neither may be reported as native-delivered.

receipt_id.description: Host-issued unique identifier for this delivery event.

client.description: Typed client identity that loaded the content (plan convention 3).

sessionId.description: Session the content was loaded into.

sourceHash.description: Content digest the host claims to have loaded natively.

deliveredAt.description: When the host loaded the content.

mechanism.description: How the host loaded it (e.g. workspace_rules, native_load, system_prompt_injection).
